# Okudagram

Okudagram is a dark theme modeled on Star Trek: The Next Generation, recreating Okuda-style displays in a late-TNG palette of peach, lavender, red, amber and blue on a near-black background. It uses system-shipped condensed sans and monospaced fallbacks and uppercase UI chrome with wide tracking. The recorded description states that support is desktop-only, with light mode and mobile unsupported.

![Okudagram screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jalad25/Okudagram/HEAD/assets/screenshot.png)

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a Star Trek: The Next Generation–inspired dark theme that recreates Okuda-style colorful displays with a late-TNG palette (peach, lavender, red, amber, blue) on a near-black background. Use system-shipped condensed sans and monospaced fallbacks, uppercase UI chrome with wide tracking, and desktop-only support: light mode and mobile unsupported."
}
